title: Glowing cheese wedge
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow effect -->
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE566' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE566' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFC107'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseSide' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFB300'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E6A000'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseBack' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#F0B800'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#D4A000'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='cheeseFront' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFCA28'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB300'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow behind cheese -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='55' r='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- back face of wedge -->
  <polygon points='22,35 78,30 72,62 28,68' fill='url(#cheeseBack)'/>

  <!-- left side face -->
  <polygon points='22,35 28,68 28,82 22,48' fill='url(#cheeseSide)'/>

  <!-- top face (big triangle-ish) -->
  <polygon points='22,35 78,30 72,62 28,68' fill='url(#cheeseTop)'/>

  <!-- front face -->
  <polygon points='28,68 72,62 72,78 28,82' fill='url(#cheeseFront)'/>

  <!-- cheese highlight on top edge -->
  <polygon points='24,37 76,32 70,60 30,65' fill='#FFE44D' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- holes on top face -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='46' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#E6A000'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='46' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#D49400'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='42' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#E6A000'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='42' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#D49400'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#E6A000'/>

  <!-- holes on front face -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='73' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#E6A000'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='73' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#D49400'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='70' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#E6A000'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='70' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#D49400'/>

  <!-- hole on left side -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='55' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#D49400'/>

  <!-- subtle shine line along top edge -->
  <line x1='26' y1='38' x2='74' y2='33' stroke='#FFF3A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- sparkles around cheese -->
  <g fill='#FFFBE0'>
    <polygon points='82,22 83,25 86,26 83,27 82,30 81,27 78,26 81,25'/>
    <polygon points='15,25 16,27 18,28 16,29 15,31 14,29 12,28 14,27'/>
    <polygon points='85,72 86,74 88,75 86,76 85,78 84,76 82,75 84,74'/>
  </g>
</svg>
